paragraphs: These are observations from one completed run, with no scientific verdict or performance claim. Goal GOAL-ECDLP-001; hypothesis H-ECDLP-51f052; experiment EXP-ECDLP-a9b6a5; run RUN-ECDLP-967315.

The complete workload was two public synthetic prime-field curves, 64 public source scalars per curve, and 35,840 tuple/sign branches per source: 4,587,520 new attempts. The frozen seed0 shuffle, generators and old eight atoms were preserved while appending eight atoms. No new m8 trials, target Q, secret labels, pilot or early-rank stop were used. One trial requested; one completed; zero failed or timed out.

The historical m8 reference is RUN-ECDLP-ea49a6. Both cases were chosen because their old collection had zero rows. The table reports exact finite counts; this conditioned panel supplies no population estimate. Nullity is labeled arithmetic U minus recorded rank. A larger base also increases the unknown-column count.

The native independent checker replayed every branch status and accepted witness, checked transported encoding equations, and recomputed projected matrices, affine/augmented ranks and kernel certificates. Its recorded status is passed with no failed checks. This separate implementation was developed in the same engineering session; the independently staffed sealed review is a distinct stage.

Exploratory arithmetic on the recorded matrices: all 15 unknown columns have a nonzero coefficient in at least one accepted row on both curves. The nullities are therefore not explained by entirely untouched columns in this retained stream. This support count was added after observing the data; it is not a preregistered primary metric or a general rank obstruction.

Field/group/pow-call/hash counters, matrix units, source checkpoints and every acceptance/rejection status are retained in native data. These are partial S: pow internals, Python bookkeeping, general byte movement, complete independent primitive counts, compression, upload and readback remain excluded. Times are diagnostic on an unisolated host and all exported clocks have wall_valid=false. Historical and candidate timings do not establish a matched cost comparison.

Canonical compressed objects were published and freshly read back before the native receipt was sealed. Logical and stored hashes, canonical manifests and custody records remain authoritative; export-inputs is an ignored reconstructible analysis cache. No prescribed-computation proof or ECDLP reduction follows from checksums, schema acceptance or replay.
